hints.title: Frequency Grouping
hints.text: If a power value v is selected, all instances of v should be taken together for a total of v * count[v] damage.

hints.title: Damage Incompatibility
hints.text: Taking value v precludes taking spells with power v - 1, v - 2, v + 1, or v + 2.

hints.title: Linear Subproblem Transition
hints.text: Sort distinct values. For index i, binary search for the largest index p where val[p] < val[i] - 2, and transition dp[i] = max(dp[i - 1], dp[p] + val[i] * count[val[i]]).

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```python
import bisect
from collections import Counter

class Solution:
    def maximumTotalDamage(self, power: list[int]) -> int:
        cnt = Counter(power)
        vals = sorted(cnt.keys())
        m = len(vals)
        dp = [0] * (m + 1)
        
        for i in range(m):
            v = vals[i]
            gain = v * cnt[v]
            idx = bisect.bisect_left(vals, v - 2)
            dp[i + 1] = max(dp[i], dp[idx] + gain)
            
        return dp[m]
```

variables: m: number of distinct spell powers
complexity.notes: Sorting distinct values and binary search queries take O(m log m).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive branch search takes exponential O(2^m) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(m) table stores maximum damage prefix DP.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Aggregate identical values and formulate non-adjacent House Robber dynamic programming.
